reason: Klaim al-uzza-c01–c06 mendokumentasikan pemujaan, kubus batu suci dan arca tanpa deskripsi bentuk, serta perlindungan tanpa manifestasi visual aktif. Tidak ada dasar untuk perempuan generik atau efek perlindungan tertentu.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: No image call made. Source fidelity takes priority; no body or active manifestation invented.
